newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat rollovers boost volume, prices hold.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat rollovers boost volume, prices hold.

text.p: Volume returned to the Australian wheat futures market on Wednesday as traders rolled over contracts from January into March.
In a total of 58 trades on the Sydney Futures Exchange, 27 rollovers took place from the January to March contracts as traders preferred to buy March contracts than take delivery of wheat.
Prices were generally steady with the March contract falling by A$1.00 a tonne to A$160.00 a tonne on the trade but with settlement prices steady on overnight SYCOM prices.

Garry Hopper of ANZ Futures Ltd said the futures market continued to take direction from the Australian Wheat Board's (AWB) pool price and was not expected to move greatly until the pool price changed.
The AWB on Monday announced a steady estimated pool price of A$185.00 a tonne for Australian Standard White.
